caption: The drawing depicts a square composed of a grid of nine smaller squares arranged in a 3x3 formation. Within this grid, the four corner squares and the center square feature a tan and brown plaid pattern, while the four edge squares positioned between the corners consist of two distinct designs: two squares display a deep red and black plaid pattern, and the other two squares exhibit a dark blue background with yellow-green vine and flower motifs. The composition places the patterned squares alternately, creating a checkerboard effect. The background is a plain, off-white color with a faint aged texture, and the composition is centrally placed on the page.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
